environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 instance behind an AWS Application Load Balancer with default configuration. ALB performs TLS termination and forwards traffic to port 8080. Security group allows inbound on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF is associated with the ALB. Application is accessed directly via ALB DNS name. Session validation is performed by a sidecar container that checks JWT tokens but does not inspect query parameters.

config.network: ALB -> target group port 8080, no WAF association
config.auth: JWT validation sidecar (checks Authorization header only)
config.database: SQLite local file, no query parameterization on search endpoint
